instructions: Agent HUD shows AI coding agents' quota, usage and sessions at the Mac's notch. These tools read what its hover panel shows and rearrange it, for every screen or for one, restyle one screen's resting HUD, and change an app setting the user asks for by name. A change is a draft until the user presses Save in the panel. A layout edit holds the panel open for two minutes; call finish_hud_edit when you are done.

tools.description: Read what the Agent HUD hover panel shows now: its blocks (one per agent or API provider), each block's accounts, with the id a layout names one by, its email or name and its plan, and its rows in the order shown with their latest readings, and each API balance with runsOutAt, when it runs out at the pace the balance itself fell over the last day, and over the block's period cost, the estimated cost of the requests recorded, burnPerDay, that cost per day, and burnRunsOutAt, when the balance runs out at that pace; the layout in effect, whether reset countdowns show, the panel's width and height and whether it scrolls, and the widgets and measures each block accepts; how many sessions it lists, over what period and in what order, and the agents and projects it can narrow them to, each project with its id and name; its token chart's period, the agents and models it can draw and its total; the attached screens, each with its resting HUD's style, the look it draws now, the agents it can show, agentPanelWidth, the width of one agent's own panel on a dock that separates its agents, and whether an edit holds its panel open; and app, the whole app's settings as drawn now, with appUnsaved, whether an unsaved draft of them waits: appearance; matchScreen, with which a screen's style draft also restyles the app's windows and the menu-bar menu on that screen; botLogos, whether marks turn into bots on a Dynamic dock, a Simple panel and reminders; showMenuBarIcon; language, and writtenIn, the language names are written in, both read only; and hover: pressOptionToOpen, openAtTopEdge, and delayMs and collapseDelayMs in milliseconds. Call it before changing the layout; block, row, account and screen keys and project ids come from here. Names are written as the panel shows them, in the application's language.

screen.description: A screen key from get_hud for that screen's own layout; 'all', the default, for the shared layout the other screens use.

tools.name: get_hud

tools.description: Show a picture of the Agent HUD hover panel as the layout in effect draws it, a draft included, account names masked, session titles left out, or with agent one agent's own panel, or with show 'hud' a screen's resting HUD; glass is one stand-in. Use it to check a change; get_hud reads it as data.

agent.description: An agent by name from that screen's shows in get_hud, or by its block's key, to draw its own panel instead of the whole one: the card a click on its mark opens beside it, agentPanelWidth wide, on a dynamic or simple HUD with separateAgents on. Needs a screen key; not with show 'hud'.

screen.description: A screen key from get_hud for that screen's own layout; 'all', the default, for the shared layout the other screens use.

show.description: What to draw: the hover panel, the default, or the screen's resting HUD, which needs a screen key.

tools.name: get_hud_screenshot

tools.description: Propose a layout for the Agent HUD hover panel: its blocks, their rows' order and the accounts each shows, its sections and reset countdowns, which are also the switches of Settings' Expanded panel, its session rows, token chart and style, its width included, and the screen's resting HUD: which agents it shows and, for one screen, its mode, edge, sizes, appearance, material, glass style and glow. Send the whole layout you want; anything left out uses the default, and a HUD style field left out stays as saved. A call with only hud style fields leaves the layout as it is. What the layout from get_hud holds for a block, a row, an account, an agent, a project or a model not listed now can be sent back as it is. It shows at once as an unsaved draft: the user keeps it with Save in the panel, and it is dropped when Agent HUD restarts. Pass from 'default' to propose the built-in layout instead, 'previous' for the last saved one, for a screen with the resting HUD style that went with it, or 'shared' to have a screen use the shared layout again; hud.reset proposes a screen's default HUD style. A layout edit holds the panel open on screen for two minutes from the call, and a call with only hud style fields closes it so the HUD shows; call finish_hud_edit when you are done. app changes the whole app's own settings, its appearance, matchScreen, botLogos, showMenuBarIcon and hover, for every screen, as a draft the same Save keeps: name it only when the user explicitly asks for one of those settings, never as a side effect of arranging the panel. A call that leaves app out leaves them as they are, and a call with only app changes them alone and opens nothing.

app.description: The whole app's own settings, for every screen whatever screen is named, as get_hud lists them under app. Name app only when the user explicitly asks for one of these settings, never as a side effect of arranging the panel. It is a draft until the user presses Save in the panel; a field left out stays as saved, so an app that sets nothing drops the draft.

appearance.description: The Appearance of the app's windows and the menu-bar menu: system follows macOS. Not while matchScreen is on, as Settings greys it out then.

botLogos.description: Marks turn into bots on a Dynamic dock, a Simple panel and reminders; one switch for every screen.

collapseDelayMs.description: How long the panel stays after the pointer leaves it, in milliseconds, 0 to 1500 in steps of 50.

delayMs.description: How long hovering waits before it opens the panel, in milliseconds, 0 to 1500 in steps of 50.

openAtTopEdge.description: Reaching the screen's top edge above the HUD opens the panel without the hover delay.

pressOptionToOpen.description: Hovering opens the panel only with Option pressed.

language.description: Read only, as get_hud lists it; only Settings changes the Language.

matchScreen.description: Each window and the menu-bar menu take the look of the HUD on the screen they are on, a screen's style draft included, in place of appearance.

showMenuBarIcon.description: The menu-bar icon and its menu; false hides them, and the HUD's panel keeps the draft's Save and Discard.

writtenIn.description: Read only, as get_hud lists it.

accounts.description: Ids of the accounts to show, from the block's accounts in get_hud; none for every account. A list of every account the block has now still hides one that joins later.

columns.description: Cells on a line for the ring and number widgets, 2 to 6; 4 if left out.

countdown.description: Whether this quota block shows its reset times, whatever the layout's countdown says; the layout's if left out.

hiddenRows.description: Keys of the block's rows to hide, from get_hud.

measures.description: What its picker offers, in order, the first shown first: quota, burn, tokens, cost. On an API balance's number, quota is the balance beside its estimated cost, burn the cost per day over its period and when the balance runs out at it, and cost the estimated cost beside that pace; its chart offers cost alone. One means no picker; none means all its widget offers.

period.description: For the chart widget, the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days its bars cover, day if left out; for an API balance, what its estimated cost, burn rate and chart cover, its estimated cost in the menu bar's tooltip too, the token chart's period if left out. For no other block.

ringSize.description: Ring size for the ring widget; medium if left out.

rows.description: Keys of the block's rows, from get_hud, in the order to show them; rows left out keep their order after them.

span.description: The whole line, the default, or half of it beside the next block if that is half too. Not for bar rows.

widget.description: How the block is drawn: bar rows, a ring, a number or a chart. An API balance takes number, its card, or chart, its estimated cost over its period.

blocks.description: What differs from the default for each block, by block key from get_hud.

countdown.description: Whether the quota blocks show their reset times where a block gives no countdown of its own; Settings' Reset countdown. True if left out.

from.description: Propose the built-in layout, the last saved one, or for a screen the shared layout, instead of the one described here. Only 'previous' brings a screen's HUD style with it.

hiddenSections.description: The panel's sections to hide; Settings' Session list, Quota details and Token usage switch sessions, blocks and tokens.

hud.description: The resting HUD: the marks of a Dynamic dock, the items of a Simple panel, the glow, its colours and its material; a style field left out stays as saved.

agents.description: Agents it shows, in order, by name from get_hud's screens; none shows every agent. The menu bar follows it where the layout is drawn: the menu opened on that screen, and the status item's figure and colours on the first screen get_hud lists.

appearance.description: Its colours, its panel's and its cards' too: dark, light, or system to follow macOS's light or dark setting. At a hardware notch a notch HUD stays dark in the notch's row, black or black glass; the panel and the cards it opens into take the look.

edge.description: Dynamic or simple: the edge it is parked on.

edgeDistance.description: Dynamic: logos' distance from the edge in points, 0 to 20.

glassStyle.description: What glass is made of: clear or regular Liquid Glass, which the HUD draws alike, as clear, and a window that matches its screen as regular, or material, an even frosted blur; Clear and Regular are a frosted blur before macOS 26. Kept while the material is solid, as Settings keeps it.

glassTransparency.description: Read only: glass's transparency as get_hud lists it, which can be sent back as listed; transparency sets the material's own.

amplitude.description: Breathe effect: how deep a breath dips, 0 to 1.

blur.description: Blur style: feather in points, 0 to 36.

gridCore.description: Grid styles: rows held at full strength, 0 to 8 in whole steps.

gridDensity.description: Grid styles: how much of its cell a mark fills, past 1 into its neighbours, 0.5 to 1.5 in steps of 0.05.

gridFade.description: Grid styles: rows it fades over after them, 0 to 8 in whole steps.

gridPitch.description: Grid styles, all but blur: spacing between cells in points, 4 to 12 in whole steps.

idleSpeed.description: Seconds a cycle takes while every agent is idle, 1 to 24 in steps of 0.5.

outwardOnly.description: Blur style: fade outward from the rim only.

range.description: Blur style: reach in points, 0 to 36.

speed.description: Seconds a cycle takes while an agent works, 1 to 12.

logoGap.description: Dynamic: gap between logos, as a share of a logo, 0.1 to 0.6.

logoSize.description: Dynamic: logo size in points, 20 to 60.

material.description: Solid, or the system's glass, which shows the desktop through it blurred, light or dark as the appearance and the desktop make it; solid while Reduce Transparency is on. At a hardware notch a notch HUD stays dark in the notch's row, black or black glass; the panel and the cards it opens into take the look.

mode.description: For one screen only, as is every field but agents. notch needs a screen with a notch.

position.description: Dynamic or simple: its centre along that edge, 0 to 1. A notch HUD made a dock at the top centre starts at 0, clear of the notch.

reset.description: True proposes the screen's default style, the placement its hardware is given, dark and solid, and the default glow, with no other style field.

ringWidth.description: Simple: ring stroke in points, 1 to 4.

separateAgents.description: Dynamic or simple: hovering a mark opens that agent's own panel.

showLogos.description: Dynamic: false leaves the backdrop alone.

showNumbers.description: Simple: the percentage beside each mark.

showRings.description: Simple: a ring round each mark.

simpleGap.description: Simple: gap between agents, as a share of a ring, 0.1 to 0.6.

simpleSize.description: Simple: ring diameter in points, 20 to 60.

solidTransparency.description: Read only: solid's transparency as get_hud lists it, which can be sent back as listed; transparency sets the material's own.

transparency.description: How much of the desktop shows through, glass's or solid's as the material is: glass lays less of the appearance's colour beneath it, solid draws less of its fill, all of it at 0; Solid, Clear and Regular draw three fifths of it, 0.6 at 1, and Material all of it; 0 to 1. It sets the transparency of the material the HUD would have; get_hud lists what each keeps as solidTransparency and glassTransparency.

order.description: Block keys from get_hud, in the order the panel shows them.

revision.description: The revision get_hud returned; when given and no longer current the call is refused.

screen.description: A screen key from get_hud for that screen's own layout; 'all', the default, for the shared layout the other screens use.

sections.description: The panel's sections, in the order it shows them.

sessions.description: Which sessions the session rows list, and in what order.

agents.description: Only these agents' sessions, names from get_hud's sessions.offeredAgents; none for every agent.

limit.description: Rows at most, 1 to 10; 5 if left out.

period.description: How long after its last activity an ended session is still listed: day, the last 24 hours, the default, or week, the last 7 days. Sessions at work are listed whatever the period.

projects.description: Only these projects' sessions, ids from get_hud's sessions.offeredProjects: a project's folder written with ~, a Git repository's worktrees counted as one project, or unassigned for sessions with no folder. A path, absolute or with ~, inside a project or a worktree of it names that project, so your own working directory names the project you work in; it is listed by its id. None for every project.

sort.description: How the rows are ordered: active, the default, lists sessions at work first, those waiting for approval ahead of those running, then the others by their last activity; date lists every session by its last activity, newest first, whatever its state.

states.description: Only sessions in these states; none for all.

style.description: How the whole panel is set.

separators.description: False drops the lines between blocks and sections.

spacing.description: Room between sections, blocks and rows; regular if left out.

width.description: The whole panel's width, 480 to 720 points; 540 if left out.

tokens.description: The token chart's period, agents and models.

agents.description: Only these agents' tokens, names from get_hud's tokens.offeredAgents; none for every agent.

models.description: Only these models' tokens, ids from get_hud's tokens.offeredModels, of the agents named if any are; none for every model.

period.description: What the token chart shows when the panel opens: the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days; day if left out.

tools.name: draft_hud

tools.description: Drop the unsaved draft so the Agent HUD panel returns to the saved layout and, for a screen, its resting HUD to its saved style; a draft of the app's own settings stays. Like a layout edit it holds the panel open, unless it drops a HUD style alone.

screen.description: A screen key from get_hud for that screen's own layout; 'all', the default, for the shared layout the other screens use.

tools.name: discard_hud_draft

tools.description: Say your edit of the Agent HUD panel is done, so the panel an edit held open closes unless the user's pointer is on it. Drafts stay as they are, waiting for the user's Save.

screen.description: A screen key from get_hud to let go of that screen's panel; 'all', the default, for every screen's.

tools.name: finish_hud_edit
